# CanPatentIt

> CanPatentIt is a US patent strategy service for deep-technology founders, engineers and investors. It helps decide what to protect and how: patentability and prior-art searches, provisional applications, US patent prosecution, and IP strategy for funding diligence. CanPatentIt is a brand of Metayage Private Limited, an intellectual property services company founded in 2006.

Nothing on this site is legal advice and no outcome is guaranteed. Contact: mugilvannan@myipstrategy.com

## Services
- [Patentability & Prior Art Search](https://canpatentit.com/services/patentability-prior-art): Patentability, state-of-the-art, freedom-to-operate and invalidity searches that turn patent data into clear next steps.
- [Provisional Patent Applications](https://canpatentit.com/services/provisional-applications): Establish an early US filing date with a technical disclosure built around your real invention, and plan the route to a full filing.
- [US Patent Prosecution](https://canpatentit.com/services/us-patent-prosecution): Drafting, examination, office action responses and issue-stage upkeep for US applications, with the technical detail and strategy your invention deserves.
- [IP Strategy & Diligence](https://canpatentit.com/services/ip-strategy-diligence): Freedom-to-operate, patent scope, validity, ownership and trademark diligence, plus ongoing IP strategy for founders and investors.

## Key facts
- A US provisional application secures an early filing date and expires after 12 months; a non-provisional must be filed within that window to keep the priority date.
- Most patent applications are published about 18 months after the earliest filing date.
- Patents are national or regional; there is no single international patent.
